title: gpu-weekly-utilization-export-na-clusters
summary: Weekly export of GPU utilization metrics (per cluster / per pool) for North America region. Source: Grafana export (dashboard: infra/gpu/pools) with additional annotations from SRE shift notes. Purpose: capacity planning and near-term autoscale tuning (next commit cycle).
notes: Produced as part of weekly capacity sync. Flags: pool 'short-lived-batch' has rising p95 (>85%) on Feb 15-16, consider adding 8xA10 burst nodes before next marketing batch run. Cluster 'na-west-2-primary' shows uneven distribution across pools — suspected scheduler packing issue. Data includes estimated idle_time_pct (based on GPU allocation vs GPU runtime).
interpretation: Key takeaways: 1) short-lived-batch pool in na-west-2-primary shows sustained high p95 on 2025-02-15/16 indicating latency/backlog risk — recommended short-term: add 8 A10 nodes (burst pool) or increase per-job timeouts and aggregate tiny tasks. 2) Training fleet (na-east-1) experienced two high-util days (12th and 14th) due to scheduled experiments — consider pre-booking reserved capacity for training windows. 3) Idle_time_pct spikes on 2025-02-11 and 02-17 suggest aggressive scale-down behavior; validate autoscaler cooldowns and pod packing to avoid fragmentation. Action items: [A] Ops to open JIRA INFRA-1010 to add temporary burst nodes for 02-18 run; [B] Scheduler team to audit bin-packing heuristics for na-west-2-primary; [C] Product to confirm expected marketing batch schedule next week. Metrics caveats: derived from Grafana export; p95 calculated over 5-min buckets, avg_util is mean of per-GPU utilization sampled at 10s.
